result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. The main visual problems are horizontal content clipping in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (restaurant name and card cut off at the right edge) and a partially clipped category chip, with no visible scroll affordance. These are minor-to-moderate layout polish issues rather than functional breakage.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, truncating the restaurant name mid-word with no ellipsis or visual cue that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a fade/peek indicator so users understand the row scrolls horizontally, and ensure truncated names use a proper ellipsis instead of being clipped mid-word.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') shows a partially visible chip cut off at the right edge with no scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Provide a subtle gradient fade or partial-chip peek to signal horizontal scrollability of the filter chips.

issues.description: The '-100%' discount badge on the bottom pizza card is ambiguous and could be misread (a 100% discount implies a free item, which may be a data/content error).
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion value and use clearer copy (e.g., 'Free item' or the actual percentage) to avoid confusing users.

issues.description: The notification bell relies on a small red dot to indicate unread alerts, which is a weak visual cue and may be missed by users with low vision or color-vision deficiencies.
issues.suggestion: Add a numeric badge or a higher-contrast/larger indicator for unread notifications.
